children.prompt: Determine how many wooden planks are needed to make 20 fence sections.

teachingMapping.rationale: Classification of revised source content; no teaching-content edits.

answer.worked: Each extra section adds 3 planks; the first uses 4. Thus $P=3n+1$. For $n=20$, $P=3(20)+1=61$ planks.
